text:
Priya (CS): Heads up — NovaTech renewal coming up next week. They want to shift from 12mo to 9mo, add 15 seats, and request invoice split between EU entity and US ops. Also asking if we can apply onboarding credit to prorated term. Any blockers?
Sam (Sales): thanks. Do we have a pricing impact for 9mo vs 12mo? they want same unit price but shorter term.
Priya (CS): they sign same commit amount but will pay across two entities. Procurement insists on separate invoices. Risk: legal/PO time.
Tom (Legal): Separate invoices ok, need to confirm PO and tax IDs. Also check SOW amendment language for term change. I'll draft a short amendment.
Maria (Billing): FYI — invoice-split is possible but we need vendor codes for both entities and the billing contacts. Tax/tariff flags for EU.
Priya (CS): They offered to accept a mid-term proration. Can onboarding credit apply to invoice A (EU) or must go to consolidated customer account?
Maria (Billing): Credits typically apply to billing account level. If they need it split, we can apply pro rata across invoices but needs approval.
Sam (Sales): Let's keep unit price same. Product discount only if commit changes. I'll push to keep price flat. @Tom can you add a clause "prorated onboarding credit applied pro rata across invoices" ?
Tom (Legal): Yep. I'll add a 2-line amendment and send for e-sign.
BillingBot: Generated draft invoice preview:
```
INVOICE DRAFT
Customer: NovaTech EU (Entity A) — €9,375 — 9mo prorated seats
Customer: NovaTech US (Entity B) — $6,250 — remainder seats
Onboarding credit: €1,000 applied to Entity A
```
Priya (CS): perfect. One more ask — customer wants enablement session scheduled in first 30 days post-sign and a 'go-live' checklist. Can PMs commit?
Sam (Sales): I'll coordinate enablement; include 2 sessions and training materials. No additional cost.
Tom (Legal): Amendment will include schedule for onboarding and acceptance criteria.
Maria (Billing): Once legal signs, I can produce two invoices and apply credit as discussed. Need vendor codes + PO numbers by EOD Thursday.
Priya (CS): I'll send a consolidated checklist to the customer and collect PO/vendor codes. Thanks all :rocket: 
Sam (Sales): great. tagging next steps:
- Tom: amendment draft and DocuSign
- Maria: pre-author invoice templates
- Priya: collect PO/vendor codes + confirm onboarding dates
I'll follow up with NovaTech this afternoon.
Priya (CS): noted — updating renewals board.
